description: This file defines a set of classes and functions implementing Transformer architecture components in PyTorch, including Transformer, TransformerEncoder, TransformerDecoder, their respective layers, and utility functions for mask generation. It is a core implementation of the Transformer model used in neural network architectures for sequence modeling tasks.

classes.name: Transformer
classes.description: A PyTorch module implementing a basic Transformer architecture with encoder and decoder components, supporting masking and causal attention. It serves as a reference implementation for sequence modeling tasks.

classes.name: TransformerEncoder
classes.description: Encapsulates a stack of TransformerEncoderLayer instances with optional normalization, enabling encoding sequences with attention mechanisms.

classes.name: TransformerDecoder
classes.description: Encapsulates a stack of TransformerDecoderLayer instances with optional normalization, used for decoding sequences with attention to encoder outputs.

classes.name: TransformerEncoderLayer
classes.description: A single layer of Transformer encoder comprising self-attention and feedforward neural network components with normalization and dropout.

classes.name: TransformerDecoderLayer
classes.description: A single decoder layer of the Transformer, including self-attention, cross-attention, and feedforward modules with normalization and dropout.

methods.description: Generates a square subsequent mask for sequence masking to prevent attending to subsequent positions (causal mask).

methods.description: Class method that wraps _generate_square_subsequent_mask for use within Transformer class.
